title: Jetpacks!
body:
# Jetpacks!
"Wow, this datapack adds jetpacks!" "Why?"
## How to use
1. First get an Iron Chestplate
2. Then name it "Jetpack" in an anvil, I know, its not very creative.
3. Then Crouch and It will fly you up in the air
## Features
1. A jetpack, duh.
2. It also has flame particles, it wouldn't be much of a jetpack if it didn't.
3. It doesn't have landing support, just shift right before you fall.
## Notes
- Again there is no landing support
- This can be safely added to any world
